mechanism_narrative: A positive change in the FEDFUNDS rate over the past 3 months is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates and reduced equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS has risen by > 0.1% over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.0, the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened inflation concerns and potential monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5.0% and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 850.0 thousand units, the S&P 500 is expected to produce positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to strong labor market conditions and robust housing demand.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0 and HOUST > 850.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by GDP growth above 2.0% and inflation above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to overvaluation and potential monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL growth > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
